title: Greek Lemon Rice
description: Buttery, lemony rice with a hit of garlic and dill — the classic taverna side
instructions: Melt 2 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 1 cup rice and stir to coat, toasting for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in 2 cups stock and 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, then cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and let stand, covered, without lifting the lid, for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork, then stir in the juice and zest of 1 lemon and 2 tbsp chopped dill. Taste and adjust salt.
notes: For extra flavor, swap 1 tbsp of the butter for the fat rendered off your souvlaki skewers if you're grilling.
